title: Exchange Identities and Computational Diagnostics for Triangle-Free Graph Bipartization
description: Corrected v2 release of a reproducible computational and structural study of a five-vertex induction approach to triangle-free graph bipartization. The release includes the corrected preprint, exact checking code, reduced-state certificates, source corpus records, deterministic verification scripts, audit output, citation metadata, and SHA-256 checksums. A key correction is that the empty-flip bound already proves the five-set induction target whenever L(G) <= 4k-1; thus at k=3 the automatic range extends through L(G)=11. The saved global-L=11 3-for-3 audit is therefore presented as exchange-structure evidence rather than a necessary proof certificate. The full Erdős triangle-free bipartization conjecture remains open.
